notes: The print-industry standard corner radius is 1/8 in = 3.175 mm; 3.5 mm is the common metric die-line value and is what most card printers quote. The two are interchangeable at this scale.

Poker is often quoted as 63 x 88 mm; the exact imperial size is 63.5 x 88.9 mm (2.5 x 3.5 in). Geometry should use width_mm/height_mm (the exact values); nominal is for matching a publisher or printer spec sheet.
UNO / UNO Junior is 56 x 87 mm, the 'Standard USA' sleeve size. It is NOT bridge: bridge is 57 x 89 mm (2.25 x 3.5 in).

bridge.label: Bridge (reference size, not used by the UNO Junior box)

uno-junior.label: UNO Junior
uno-junior.sleeve: Standard USA card sleeve (56 x 87 mm)
uno-junior.not_bridge: Bridge is 57 x 89 mm; UNO Junior is 1 mm narrower and 2 mm shorter.
